latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — enables fast, cloud-based video editing for Windows users.

- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and get professional edits with simple instructions.
- Processed videos exported as 1080p MP4, ready to download in 1-2 minutes for short clips.
- No software installation or complex interfaces — all editing is done through chat.
- Handles multiple formats and common workflows: trimming, transitions, text overlays, and audio.
- Automatic backend connection and session management for a seamless experience.
- Built-in credit handling, status updates, and clear error messages for easy troubleshooting.
